Wonderful co-op game that never loses your attention. There is always something to do in any given environment, little things like arcade machines and minigames like horseshoes make this game all the more competitive with your coop partner. This game does feature a HEAVY amount of quick-time actions if that's not your thing though.

A Way Out is one of the most unique and engaging co-op experiences I’ve ever played. Hazelight Studios crafted something truly special here — a cinematic, narrative-driven game that can only be played with another person, and it uses that concept to its full advantage.

From the very beginning, the story of Leo and Vincent pulls you in. It's an emotional, action-packed journey filled with tension, humor, and heart. What makes this game shine is how it blends split-screen co-op with gameplay mechanics that constantly require communication and teamwork. Whether you’re planning a prison break, coordinating a stealth mission, or just playing basketball with a kid, it always feels personal and immersive.

The pacing is excellent, the characters are well-written, and the ending — without giving anything away — is genuinely impactful. It’s rare for a game to stick the landing this well.

Technically, the game runs smoothly and looks great, especially considering it’s a smaller studio project. The music and voice acting are also top-notch, enhancing the cinematic feel.

If you’re looking for a game to play with a friend, partner, or even a sibling, A Way Out is an absolute must. It’s not just a game — it’s an experience. Hazelight has proven that gaming can tell powerful stories in ways other mediums can’t.

9/10 — Highly recommended for co-op fans and narrative lovers alike.

A Way Out is a co-op adventure where you and a friend struggle through prison escapes, climb on each other’s backs, awkwardly argue, and laugh at each other’s missteps. Perfect for testing friendships—especially with the endings!

"A Way Out" is a masterpiece of gaming innovation, delivering an unforgettable split-screen co-op experience that stands out in today's market. Playing with a friend, the story, action, and music blend seamlessly, creating a cinematic adventure that's both thrilling and emotionally charged. The unique requirement for teamwork to progress the narrative not only enhances the gameplay but also deepens the bond between players. It's like being part of an action-packed, heart-wrenching movie. Games like this are a rare gem, offering a truly exceptional and memorable gaming journey.
